# Superfoods Partners

> Hong Kong–based B2B sourcing of matcha and superfood powders, direct from origin. Every batch verified, lab-tested and documented, routed through one trusted hub — from sample to full container. The sourcing arm of the Pure Matcha Partners family.

## Products
- [Matcha — bulk / wholesale](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/matcha): Stone-ground green tea, shade-grown at origin. Ceremonial, premium and culinary grades; single-origin Japan and China; Organic & Conventional.
- [Hojicha](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/hojicha): Charcoal-roasted green tea powder — low caffeine, deep aroma.
- [Ube powder](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/ube): Purple yam powder — colour and flavour, from the Philippines and China.
- [Lion's mane](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/lions-mane): Fruiting-body mushroom powder for nutraceutical formulation.
- [Hibiscus](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/hibiscus): Tart, ruby-red botanical for teas and beverages (East China and Egypt).
- [Jasmine tea powder](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/jasmine-tea-powder): Jasmine-scented green tea, finely milled.
- [Oolong tea powder](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/oolong-tea-powder): Semi-oxidised tea, roasted and finely milled.
- [Earl grey tea powder](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog/earl-grey-tea-powder): Black tea with natural bergamot, finely milled.
- [Full catalogue](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/catalog): All products, B2B.

## Company
- [About](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/about): The Hong Kong–based sourcing arm of the Pure Matcha Partners family; direct-from-origin, trust-first.
- [Verification](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/verification): How every batch is tested, documented and traced — lab panels (pesticide residue, heavy metals, microbiology, radiation), the Verification Record™ and certifications.
- [Origins](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/origins): 13 origins across Japan, China, the Philippines and Egypt, mapped and routed through one Hong Kong hub.
- [Contact — request a quote](https://www.superfoodspartners.com/contact): Request a wholesale quote; a lab report and quote typically follow within 48 hours.

## Key facts for buyers
- Minimum order quantity: from 25 kg up to a full container.
- Lead time: 2–4 weeks, routed via the Hong Kong hub (22.32°N 114.17°E).
- Incoterms: FOB / CIF / DDP.
- Certifications: JAS Organic, EU Organic, USDA Organic, HACCP, FSSC 22000 (Kosher on request).
- Documentation: Certificate of Analysis (COA) + Verification Record™ per batch.
- Independent testing partners: Eurofins, Mérieux NutriSciences.
- Matcha grades: ceremonial, premium, culinary.

## Who we supply
Beverage manufacturers, supplement & nutraceutical brands, foodservice & QSR chains, private-label & co-packers, distributors & importers.

## Notes
- B2B supplier; pricing is quote-based (no public retail prices).
- Part of the Pure Matcha Partners family of companies.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Polish, Traditional Chinese.
